name: mcp-plugin-sandbox
description: Test marketplace bundling two sibling plugins from one repo: sandbox-mobile (XcodeBuildMCP + iOS skills) and sandbox-web (Playwright MCP + browser skills). Used to validate the multi-plugin-in-one-repo layout and independent per-plugin auto-update.

plugins.name: sandbox-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile sandbox plugin: XcodeBuildMCP + four iOS skills (list-simulators, list-devices, list-schemes, discover-projects). Includes a SessionStart hook for zero-touch per-plugin auto-update.

plugins.name: sandbox-web
plugins.description: Web sandbox plugin: Playwright MCP + two browser skills (page-snapshot, screenshot-page). Sibling to sandbox-mobile; independent versioning and updates.
